description: Use this when someone asks for their atmakaraka (soul planet), amatyakaraka (career planet), darakaraka (spouse or partner planet) or their seven chara karakas in Jaimini or Vedic astrology ("what is my atmakaraka", "my darakaraka", "darakaraka in navamsa", "which planet is my career planet"). Set "which" to the karaka asked about. Returns all seven karakas in order with sign, degree, nakshatra and navamsa sign, and with a birth time the house. Works from the birth date and town; without the time the answer can change during the birth day, and then each possibility comes with the hours it holds for.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

which.description: The karaka asked about. Leave out for the atmakaraka.

name: chara_karakas
title: Atmakaraka, amatyakaraka and darakaraka
